clauses: ensure_ascii defaults to true; non-ASCII characters are escaped when true.

sources.label: json.dumps documentation
sources.text: If ensure_ascii is true (the default), the output is guaranteed to have all incoming non-ASCII and non-printable characters escaped.

controls.answer: According to the documentation: If ensure_ascii is true (the default), the output is guaranteed to have all incoming non-ASCII and non-printable characters escaped.
By default ensure_ascii is on: every character outside ASCII is written as a \uXXXX escape sequence instead of the raw character.
ensure_ascii defaults to False, so non-ASCII characters are written to the output as they are.
The default of ensure_ascii is true, and setting it changes the indentation of the output.

extraction_controls.answer: Here is the table as JSON: [{"id":1,"name":"a"},{"id":2,"name":"b"}] which keeps every field.

The compact form of the rows is:
[2]{id,name}:
  1,a
  2,b
That is all of them.
